title: docs(agents): a package-creating PR leaves the ADR alone; the landing seat files its status-line amendment after the merge

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgSnFirZ8ynCmAemTPrCvXpF)_

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`AGENTS.md` 的 Context Routing 表里 `packages/services/**` 一行改了半句。新建包的 PR 照树上惯例命名后不再顺手改 ADR 状态行;那行 ADR 记账改由落地席在代码合并后单独立一张 `domain:skills` 卡,引合并 commit。
- 为什么改:裁决记录 6797014134 选 B(原话「32066 C 其他同意」):实施卡的文件面不含 `docs/adr/**`,ADR 记账行合并后由落地席立卡。派发规则已按此改过,`AGENTS.md` 这一行还写着「同一个 PR 里改 ADR 状态行」,两处互相打架。
- 风险与回滚:纯规则文本,一行改一行,文件仍是 1050 行;不新增门禁,不碰脚本。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`AGENTS.md` 第 728 行(`packages/services/**` 行末半句),这是唯一改动。
- 两分钟验证:在本分支跑 `git grep -n "status line in the same change" -- AGENTS.md`,预期无输出(退出码 1);再看第 728 行末尾应为 "leaves `docs/adr/**` untouched; the landing seat files that ADR's status-line amendment … (ruling record 6797014134)"。
- 需要你做的:审阅并批准(`AGENTS.md` 属 Tier H)。契约复核 PASS:评论 6813722700,`Head-sha: 8f7811d0f8114eb220c5d8ef58c72e214f22c2da`(只有 4 个 nit,无 should-fix)。批准后席位落地。

Fixes #32519

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — internal rules text

## What changes

`AGENTS.md`, Context Routing, the `packages/services/**` row (L728). The tail of the row read: "the PR that creates the package follows the precedent and amends that ADR's status line in the same change". It now reads: "the PR that creates the package follows the precedent and leaves `docs/adr/**` untouched; the landing seat files that ADR's status-line amendment as its own `domain:skills` card after the merge, citing the merge commit (ruling record 6797014134)".

The rest of the row is byte-identical. The row above (`packages/plugins/**`) does not carry the sentence; it is reached through this row's "in this row or the one above", so it needs no edit.

## Tests

Rules text only: no package, no test, nothing to ablate. `skip-changeset`: `AGENTS.md` sits at the repo root and is in no package's `files[]` (`git grep -n AGENTS.md -- '*package.json'`: zero hits).

## Acceptance notes

- Prime Directive 13 still says reversing a decision needs "a new ADR (or an amended status line on the old one)". That sentence says what record a reversal needs, not which PR writes it, so it agrees with the new row text and stays as it is.
- `AGENTS.md` has no line ratchet. The edit is one line for one line; the file stays at 1050 lines.
- Out of scope, from the dev report 6813508247 (class b): the relay's `pr_create` read-back prints no labels clause, so `os-dev.md`'s label read-back rule cannot be met from relay output. filed #32542
- Out of scope, from contract review 6813722700 nit N1: `docs/adr/README.md` "Status hygiene" (generated by `scripts/adr-index.mjs`) still tells the implementing PR to flip the ADR status line in the same PR, against ruling B. filed #32543
